properties.description: A designated promise travels with the surface while undesignated intent stays home and is counted; nothing is published by default; a promise-free surface SAYS it is promise-free and distinguishes "none stated" from "none exist"; a promise count appears in the note; designation can be withdrawn; designating leaves status and statement alone; an invented designation and a non-existent requirement are both refused (crates/reflow2-core/tests/publishable_promise.rs, 9 cases).
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED: removing the one line that carries promises fails exactly the case that names the defect, and nothing else.
properties.name: A designated promise travels with the surface while undesignated intent stays home
